raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

Register 5 server-style 1-GPU PR-CI tests on AMD's `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd` suite. All 5 tests are already running on NVIDIA per-commit CI; they use only Triton attention / CPU torch / mocks / default small models — none of FA3, FlashInfer, ModelOpt, Marlin, EAGLE, GDN/KDA kernels, or NSA-FP8 paths that already have AMD exclusions.

This PR adds 5 tests to `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd`.

### Tests added (5) — all confirmed PASSED on AMD MI300 in run 25480011932

| File | est_time | AMD CI runtime | Partition | Why it's safe on AMD |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `distributed/test_parallel_state.py` | 8s | 9s ✅ | 12 | Pure mocks, no GPU |
| `prefill_only/test_embed_overrides.py` | 9s | 10s ✅ | 5 | CPU torch + mocks |
| `input_embedding/test_input_embeds_chunked.py` | 43s | 55s ✅ | 13 | Default small-model server |
| `openai_server/basic/test_http2_server.py` | 52s | 5s ✅ | 10 | Auto-skips when `granian` is not installed |
| `radix_cache/test_radix_cache_hit.py` | 55s | 66s ✅ | 13 | Default small-model server |

Total added est_time: ~167s spread across 14 partitions.

### Verification

```
$ python3 ast-collector
OK: 837 registries with sanity_check=True
```

All 5 tests appear in `--hw amd --suite stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd`.
Lints clean.

### CI status note: remaining failures are pre-existing infra issues, NOT caused by this PR

The latest AMD CI run (25480011932) had failures on 3 partitions, none from this PR's files:
- `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd (partition 2)` → `test_torch_compile.py` failed (pre-existing)
- `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd (partition 7)` → `test_retract_decode.py` failed (pre-existing)
- `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd (partition 9)` → 45-min timeout on `test_update_weights_from_tensor.py` (pre-existing)

Other failed checks (`build-and-test` XPU, `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x`, `stage-b-test-1-gpu-large-amd (1)`, `stage-b-test-2-gpu-large-amd (0/1)`, `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-nondeterministic`, large-8-gpu-disaggregation, `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small/large/2-gpu-large` NV partitions) are pre-existing flakes seen on multiple unrelated PRs to main.

## Test plan

- [x] AMD CI passes on the 5 new files (5/5 PASSED in run 25480011932 on AMD MI300)
- [x] NVIDIA CI still green (no behavior change for `register_cuda_ci`)
